strings.sbExplainSubtitle: A simple summary of your planets' strength
strings.sbBodyWhatIs: Shadbala ('six-fold strength') measures how much power each planet has to deliver its results, by adding six independent sources of strength.
strings.sbBodyRupas: Strength is measured in Rupas (1 Rupa = 60 Virupas). Each planet needs a minimum Rupa strength to count as strong; more Rupas means it delivers its results more fully.
strings.sbBodyHowCalc: Six balas are added: Sthana (positional), Dig (directional), Kala (temporal), Chesta (motional), Naisargika (natural) and Drik (aspectual). The total is compared with the planet's required minimum to get a percentage.
strings.sbBodyHowUse: A planet above 100% comfortably delivers its significations; below 100% it needs support. Favour your strongest planets for important matters, and give the weakest ones remedies and patience.
strings.sbRemedyStrong: Well-supported — no special remedy needed; you can use this planet's periods confidently.

strings.kDefCombust: A planet too close to the Sun, so its energy is 'burnt' and weakened.

strings.kDefVargottama: A planet in the same sign in both the birth chart (D1) and the navamsa (D9) — a mark of strength.
strings.kDefOwnSign: A planet sitting in a sign it rules, where it feels at home and gives steady results.

strings.kDefPada: One of the four quarters of a nakshatra that a planet occupies.
strings.aspGrahaBody: Graha Drishti is the aspect a planet casts from its position. Every planet fully aspects the 7th house/planet from itself (a direct, face-to-face influence). In addition, Mars aspects the 4th and 8th, Jupiter the 5th and 9th, and Saturn the 3rd and 10th. Rahu and Ketu are usually given the 5th, 7th and 9th. A planet's aspect colours the planet or house it falls on with its own nature.
strings.aspRashiBody: Rashi Drishti is a sign-to-sign aspect from Jaimini astrology, independent of which planets sit there. Movable signs aspect fixed signs (except the adjacent one), fixed signs aspect movable signs (except the adjacent one), and dual signs aspect the other dual signs. It is used mainly in Jaimini prediction and for judging relationships between houses.
strings.aspDiffBody: Graha Drishti is cast by a planet and depends on where that planet sits. Rashi Drishti belongs to the sign itself and applies to whatever is placed in it. Graha Drishti is directional (planet A sees planet B), while Rashi Drishti is usually mutual between the signs. When both point to the same target, the influence is especially strong.
strings.aspPredictBody: An aspect shows where a planet extends its influence beyond its own house. A benefic aspect (Jupiter, Venus, well-placed Moon/Mercury) supports and protects the target; a malefic aspect (Saturn, Mars, Sun, Rahu, Ketu) can pressure, delay or challenge it. Reading which planets aspect a house or planet explains why results appear the way they do.

strings.avABody: Ashtakavarga is a points-based strength system in Vedic astrology. Each planet awards benefic points (bindus, also called rekhas) to the twelve signs based on its position. More points in a sign means that area of life gets smoother support during related planetary periods and transits.
strings.avSavBody: SAV (Sarva Ashtakavarga) adds together the points from all seven planets for each sign. It gives a single strength score per sign, so you can quickly see which signs — and the houses they fall in — are best supported in your chart.
strings.avBavBody: BAV (Bhinna Ashtakavarga) shows the points from a single planet across the twelve signs. It tells you which signs a specific planet supports most, which matters when that planet's dasha or transit is active.
strings.avHowToReadBody: Higher numbers are better. For SAV, an average sign scores about 28 points — above 30 is strong and below 25 needs care. For BAV, each sign ranges from 0 to 8, with 4 being average. Favour your strongest signs for important actions, and stay patient and disciplined with your weakest ones.
strings.avSavVsBavBody: SAV is the combined total of all planets and shows a sign's overall strength. BAV is a single planet's contribution and shows which planet supports that sign. Use SAV for the big picture, and BAV to understand which planet drives a sign's strength.
